notes: Shot list v0 (S3): the film draft (~3:24, 16:9, 24 fps) and, per landmark, its role on the route, hero framing (class, distance, time of day), context framing and the detail budget that follows from it. Realized by landmark bookmarks `<id>-close` (hero) and `<id>-wide` (context); probe expectations and budgets are gated by `pnpm check`. Timing becomes data/tour/timeline.json in S4. Distances are slant km from the landmark; px/km at the reference frame = refH / (2 tan(refFov/2)) / distance ≈ 1427 / distance.

detail.policy: Fixed design scale per landmark (never distance-dependent). Hero silhouette spans >= 25 % of frame height at `-close` and stays below 0.6x the host relief within 20 km; `-wide` extent >= places.json wideShotPxTarget (A 30 / B 16 px) or the landmark carries an emission / contrast cue; wide shots (>300 km) rely on terrain silhouette, contrast halo and emission sparkles. minFeatureKm = minFeaturePx x heroKm / 1427.

hobbiton.framing: low from the south-south-west up the lanes of Bag Hill: the rows of terraced round doors, Bag End under its great oak at the top, golden late light

rivendell.framing: long lens from beyond the valley lip looking up the deep gorge, the Last Homely House on its spur on the left third, the gorge head in the upper third, late-October afternoon light from the south-west (the segment's tod)
features: deep narrow gorge with sheer stratified walls and wet gullies
honey-cream halls with swept verdigris and bronze roofs
slender towers, arched galleries, cantilevered terraces
golden autumn woods under the halls' height

moria.framing: moonlit, low over the still Sirannon pool to the sheer cliff; Caradhras above, no Orthanc

lothlorien.framing: dusk over the golden canopy, the mallorn crowns of Caras Galadhon lit by blue-white lamps
features: giant silver mallorns above the canopy

argonath.framing: low pass upriver between the kings, backlit pale gold, slow reveal

rauros.framing: Nen Hithoel south end: Tol Brandir between Amon Hen and Amon Lhaw, the falls lip

isengard.framing: from the south over Nan Curunir, the ring in its basin, Orthanc against the Methedras shoulder
features: Orthanc: four faceted piers into four horns

edoras.framing: from the north-east across the braided valley, the knoll against the White Mountains

helms-deep.framing: from the north over the Deeping-coomb, the wall across the gorge mouth, the Hornburg on its spur
features: Hornburg keep and tower on a rock spur

black-gate.framing: from the Dagorlad ash plain, low, looking up at the gate, the single subject between the Towers of the Teeth, a basalt outcrop in the right foreground; Barad-dûr hidden behind the east Tower, Mount Doom hidden behind the east gate tower or offset (hazed to silhouette in S4)
features: iron wall across the pass, its level top dying into the rock
giant riveted double gate with a fang crest
Towers of the Teeth on broken crags

henneth-annun.framing: Ithilien slope, the cliff and pool in green forest

osgiliath.framing: from the east across the Anduin, the ruins on both banks, Minas Tirith behind

minas-tirith.framing: dawn from the east over the Pelennor, the seven tiers against Mindolluin, the prow splitting them
features: seven wall tiers on a Mindolluin spur

minas-morgul.framing: night in the Morgul vale from the south, the pale tiered citadel (≈ 40 % of the silhouette) and its twisted tower filling the frame height, the pale statue bridge leading in from the bottom third
features: pale walled city tiered against the mountain
twisted tower with a spiral lamp-room crown
green under-light washing up the walls

cirith-ungol.framing: the finned tower on its pinnacle at the pass, against the Mordor glow

mount-doom.framing: low over Gorgoroth, the isolated cone with its glowing crater, Barad-dur on the horizon (aimKm toward it)

barad-dur.framing: the black spire on its spur, the Eye between the horns

erebor.framing: dusk from the south, the lone massif with ridged spurs, the gate and the river leaving it

lake-town.framing: dusk over the Long Lake, the stilt town and its lanterns, Erebor on the horizon

dale.framing: the pale city on its spur before Erebor
features: pale stone city on a spur

dol-guldur.framing: the ruined triangular fortress on its bare hill in southern Mirkwood

bree.framing: golden dusk (the low sun behind the camera on the west fronts; the windows and gate lamps already lit), low from the west down the East Road on a long lens: the palisade and the lit West-gate towers, the steep roofs of the town climbing Bree-hill with small warm windows, hedgerows and the wooded crest of the hill, Weathertop on the far horizon

weathertop.framing: the lone steep tor with its bands of bedded rock and its broken crown against the dusk sky, seen from low below the crown to the south-south-east (the Weather Hills well below its crest)
features: ring of broken arches on the crown

grey-havens.framing: golden backlight from over the valley east of the town (el 24; the coast rises too steeply for an eye-level view west): the pale town stepping down to the basin on its terraces, the quays and arcaded halls, the white ship moored on the sun's path, the towers on the two rock crags framing the mouth, the shining gulf
